scenarios.title: Exalted gives a lone attacker +1/+1 until end of turn
decisions: A attacks player B with Grizzly Bears only.
Akrasan Squire's exalted trigger goes on the stack and resolves.
No blockers are declared; combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: with_exalted
variants.expected: Exalted triggers once. Grizzly Bears is a 3/3 until end of turn and deals 3 damage to B, whose life becomes 17.

variants.label: without_exalted
variants.delta: A's other creature is Savannah Lions (2/1, no abilities) instead of Akrasan Squire.
variants.expected: No exalted trigger. Grizzly Bears stays a 2/2 and deals 2 damage to B, whose life becomes 18.

scenarios.title: Each instance of exalted triggers separately
decisions: A attacks player B with Grizzly Bears only.
Both exalted triggers go on the stack and resolve.
No blockers are declared; combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: two_instances
variants.expected: Exalted triggers twice. Grizzly Bears is a 4/4 until end of turn and deals 4 damage to B, whose life becomes 16.

variants.label: one_instance
variants.delta: Aven Squire is not on A's battlefield.
variants.expected: Exalted triggers once. Grizzly Bears is a 3/3 until end of turn and deals 3 damage to B, whose life becomes 17.

scenarios.title: A creature attacks alone only if it is the sole declared attacker
decisions: A declares attackers as the variant describes.
No blockers are declared; combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: one_attacker
variants.expected: A attacked player B with Grizzly Bears only. Grizzly Bears attacks alone and exalted triggers: it is a 3/3 until end of turn and B's life becomes 17.

variants.label: two_attackers
variants.delta: A attacks player B with Grizzly Bears and Akrasan Squire instead of Grizzly Bears only.
variants.expected: Neither creature attacks alone, so exalted does not trigger. Grizzly Bears (2/2) and Akrasan Squire (1/1) deal 3 damage in total; B's life becomes 17 and neither creature gets a bonus.
